# Beag Labs

> Beag Labs builds Papyrus, an agentic ERP: one data model for a business's customers, vendors, invoices and payments, with agents that run the back-office work and people who approve what matters. Sign up at https://papyrus.beaglabs.com.

Official website: https://beaglabs.com/

## Core offering

- [Papyrus](https://beaglabs.com/products/papyrus): The agentic ERP. A data model of the business that agents understand and operate.
- [Agentic back office](https://beaglabs.com/solutions/agentic-back-office): Agents run AP, AR, intake, approvals and reconciliation.
- [Document automation](https://beaglabs.com/solutions/document-automation): Documents in, ledger out. Invoices, contracts and forms become ERP records.
- [Internal app factory](https://beaglabs.com/solutions/internal-app-factory): Apps for requests and approvals on the same data model.
- [Modernization](https://beaglabs.com/capability/modernization): Connect existing systems so agents can use them.
- [Try Papyrus](https://papyrus.beaglabs.com/signup): Sign up; Papyrus runs at your own address with Microsoft sign-in.
